findings.explanation: Net 90 payment terms force you to wait three months to get paid, creating cash flow strain.
Net 90 payment terms mean you will not be paid until 90 days after invoicing, which significantly delays your cash flow.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to request a few adjustments before signing. Here are the points I would like to discuss: - Regarding the clause "Invoices are payable Net 90.", waiting three months for payment creates cash flow strain, so I propose changing this to: Invoices are payable Net 30. - Regarding the clause "Payment period: Net 90", this timeline significantly delays cash flow, so I propose changing this to: Payment period: Net 30. Please let me know if these adjustments are acceptable to you so we can move forward. Best regards,
